_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (bank schema). Source: FAB FY2025 results, 28-Jan-2026 (bankfab.com), confirmed by The National / Aletihad / The Asian Banker. Record group net profit AED 21.11bn (+24% YoY; profit-before-tax AED 25.20bn +27%). Operating income AED 36.68bn (+16%): NII AED 20.32bn (+4%), non-interest income AED 16.35bn (+36%). Loans & advances AED 616bn (+17%); customer deposits AED 841bn (+7%). Return on tangible equity 19.2% (recorded in roe_pct); CET1 13.3%; NPL 2.2% (from 3.4%), coverage 108%. Highest-ever cash dividend 80 fils/sh (AED 8.84bn). EPS omitted (AT1-coupon adjustment to ordinary EPS not cleanly disclosed).
